scope.title: Re-verify A3 runtime-resilience controlled pilot gate

decision.reason: All four A3 criteria map to current assertions at the original thresholds (anomaly rate <=20% + degrade_to_default_decision, p99<=15ms, flag-off parity undefined, augmentation-only). A spec requiredTests drift (only perf was listed) was fixed with a coverage guard.

criterion3_flagOffParity.threshold: resolveAnomalyPatternForReviewer returns undefined when featureFlags undefined

augmentationOnly.threshold: A3 only augments reviewer context; never changes the terminal Mission decision

specDriftFixed.issue: a3-runtime-resilience-pilot.md requiredTests listed only tests/unit/performance-budgets.test.ts, omitting the classifier and counter tests that cover criteria 1/3/4.
specDriftFixed.fix: added tests/unit/anomaly-classifier.test.ts + tests/unit/deprecation-counters.test.ts + openclaw_runtime/src/observability/deprecation-counters.test.ts to requiredTests; added tests/unit/a03-a3-gate-coverage.test.ts to pin the wiring.

a3Evidence.command: vitest run anomaly-classifier.test.ts a3-deep.test.ts deprecation-counters.test.ts performance-budgets.test.ts

residual.falsePositiveSampling: The false-positive review packet sampling is a runtime sampling activity; it was not fabricated inside this gate.
residual.pilotOnly: A3 stays augmentation-only; no default-on/GA, no product lock change.
residual.scope: Deterministic unit evidence; no live provider/real-human.

independentVerification.detail: Each A3 criterion is mapped to a current assertion and re-run; the guard checks every requiredTests path exists and pins the classifier/counter wiring. No separate second-agent verifier role was run.

acceptanceCriteria.note: anomaly rate budget asserted at the original 20% threshold.
A3 does not change the terminal Mission decision.
classifier + counter tests wired into the A3 spec; coverage guard added.
72 evidence + 3 coverage tests pass, typecheck:test 0, scoped lint 0, harness validate/dry-run pass, comms 0, credential scan 0 hits, SHA256SUMS verifiable.

notMeasured: A separate second-agent independent verifier role.

landing.note: Pushed with the evidence commit in the same session; see the branch's PR.
